CustomField.description: The least a checkout can charge, in the main unit (0.50 for USD, 50 for JPY). A promotion code never takes a total below it, except to zero. Stripe's minimum for the currency (docs.stripe.com/currencies), or about 0.50 USD where Stripe's is worth far less or Stripe lists none.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The least a checkout in this currency can charge, in the main unit. Set by JForm.
CustomField.label: Minimum Charge
